study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: old criteria for GDM risk (5 historic/demographic factors)
new criteria for GDM risk (11 factors)
cohort: 820 non-diabetic Korean women with singleton pregnancies.
finding: Using the new criteria for GDM risk would have decreased the number of patients identified as high risk and thus requiring early GDM screening by half compared to the old criteria, without significant difference in sensitivity.
